# Startup voice sources

The five unchanged MP3 clips `line-1.mp3` through `line-5.mp3` come from `dsh-startup-screen-main.zip`, under `dsh-startup-screen-main/lib/assets/`. Their slot mapping follows the supplied `AUDIO-FIELDS.md`.

`line-6.wav` comes from the archive's `lib/assets/line-6.mp3`. The supplied clip was 3.700 seconds. This workbench copy ends at 1.470 seconds, after “Welcome to you” and before the following “DeepSeek Harness” phrase. It is PCM WAV, 44.1 kHz, stereo, 16-bit, with a 30 ms fade at the cut.

The retained word-free cue is the existing `cue.ogg`. The workbench continues to generate interface sound effects in its own audio module.

The archive README states its MIT license applies to its code and text, and excludes third-party audio. No license claim is made for these selected audio clips.
